prompts.background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production mobile chat background, standalone portrait image, 1024 x 1792 preferred, no UI.
Primary request: A quiet visual metaphor for chaos inside a complicated mind, where three perspectives can meet. Elegant, restrained, simple abstract atmospheric artwork for a warm Korean reflection/chat app.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory pearl mist, with a few intertwined smoky silk-like currents and loosely tangled wispy threads confined mostly to upper corners and outer edges. Subtle muted slate blue, lavender grey and warm ochre undertones mingle at edges. Hint at disorder and diverging thought paths, but keep a gentle contemplative atmosphere.
Composition: portrait full bleed. Very large, nearly uniform warm ivory central negative space, roughly central 70% of width and 75% of height, suitable for dark chat text and ivory chat panels. The bottom central region must remain especially quiet for message composer. Edge currents must be soft and understated, not a rigid frame. No hard dark details in the central reading area.
Style: refined minimal abstract atmospheric art, soft natural shading, delicate translucent mist, smooth gradients with just a little subtle paper texture.
Constraints: background artwork only, no lettering, no words, no characters, no people, no animals, no robots, no UI, no buttons, no bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Avoid busy spirals, dense detail, stars, bright neon, black hole, galaxies, lightning, hard contrast, horror. The visual chaos should be suggested through a few gently overlapping currents rather than a loud explosion.
prompts.blue:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production mobile chat avatar, one isolated simple friendly AI robot character on genuinely transparent background, square 1024 x 1024.
Primary request: A minimal, instantly recognizable AI chatbot mascot for a Korean reflection app. One softly rounded robot head with small upper torso, facing straight forward symmetrically, no tilt. This will be the blue member of a matched set of three.
Subject: squat rounded-square head taking most of the composition, small round side ear discs, one very short antenna with a round tip, simple dark navy rounded rectangular face screen, two large friendly pale oval eyes and a tiny gentle curved smile. Small rounded upper torso visible beneath head. Overall simple coherent silhouette. Dominant shell color unmistakable medium cobalt blue (#3679D7 family); subtle pale cream accents only.
Style/medium: restrained polished soft 3D illustration, matte ceramic or satin plastic, diffuse studio lighting, very soft smooth shading, no photoreal mechanical detail.
Composition: exactly one character centered, head/antenna/shoulders fully inside central 78% of canvas, generous transparent margin on all sides, face readable at 40dp, head much larger than torso, use approximately the same silhouette and camera for future orange and violet versions.
Background: true transparent alpha, no scenery, no colored or white backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image, no floor, no shadow outside silhouette.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, names, logo, watermark, badge, props, costume, symbols of specific roles, extra characters, human features. Friendly and neutral, not childish, not a complex toy. Preserve clean edges and actual transparency.
prompts.amber:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production mobile chatbot avatar, one square standalone transparent PNG, matching a three-character set.
Input image: the supplied blue robot is the edit target and exact design reference.
Primary request: create the amber color variant of this exact friendly AI robot. Change ONLY all blue exterior shell surfaces (head shell, antenna stalk, upper torso) to warm vivid amber orange (#E89A2D family), clearly orange, not beige or brown. Keep its dark navy face screen, warm cream oval eyes, smile, ear discs, antenna ball, and neck accents unchanged.
Invariants: preserve precisely the same silhouette, head shape, ears, antenna length, front-facing camera, expression, pose, proportions, placement, canvas size, and soft matte 3D shading. Exactly one robot. Same generous transparent margin. No symbols or names assigned; this is a neutral avatar whose role changes by conversation.
Alpha quality: genuine fully transparent background. Clean coherent antialiased contour; no stray detached pixels, cyan fringe, colored speckle, checkerboard, glow, ground, external shadow or background. All non-character pixels should be fully transparent.
Constraints: no text, logo, watermark, props, extra characters or UI. Make the dominant color immediately distinguishable in a 40dp chat avatar.
